Scenario fixture: rgaa-invalid-field-message (RGAA 11.10.4, 11.10.7)

Each target has a stable id of the form ifm_case_NN. A field marked aria-invalid="true" needs its message in its label or a passage linked by aria-describedby or aria-labelledby.

01 — CANTTELL: no linked passage
02 — NOT APPLICABLE: the message is linked by aria-describedby

Format : 01 23 45 67 89
